title: Portable Audit Record
description: Portable, queryable record of an action or security event. Implementations may add non-sensitive detail but must never include credentials, secrets, or raw private content.

event.description: Open event name, such as auth.authorized, tool.executed, memory.read, identity.revoked, or loop.cancelled.

actor_id.description: Authenticated actor responsible for the action; never silently replaced by the owner.

reason.description: Safe machine-readable or human-readable outcome reason.

correlation_id.description: End-to-end request or operation trace ID.

details.description: Optional non-sensitive operational metadata. Must not contain credentials, secrets, or raw private content.
